settings.title: Make song loops
settings.text: A looping background video drawn from a song's lyrics on a cloud GPU. When off, songs keep the loops they have and no new ones are made.

settings.title: Video models offered
settings.text: The models a singer may choose between when making a loop. Keep at least one.

settings.title: Default video model
settings.text: The one a loop is made with unless the singer picks another.

choices.label: Fast
choices.note: Demucs. Always offered: the others fall back to it

settings.title: Presets offered
settings.text: The qualities a singer may choose for a song's stems. One that is off is never run, not even as a fallback.

settings.title: Default for new songs
settings.text: The quality a song gets unless the singer picks another.

settings.title: Run Balanced and Best on the cloud GPU
settings.text: When off, they run on this server, which needs the RoFormer extras installed and is slow without a GPU of its own.

settings.title: Render videos in the cloud
settings.text: When off, videos render on this server.

settings.title: Start a cloud machine when Export opens
settings.text: The render then does not wait for one. A machine that goes unused stops by itself.

settings.title: Start a cloud GPU when a song starts
settings.text: It is asked for while the audio downloads, so the stems do not wait for one.

settings.title: Longest song, in minutes
settings.text: A link to a longer recording is refused before it downloads. 0 is no limit.

settings.title: Longest album, in minutes
settings.text: The longest whole-album recording a link may download to pick songs from. 0 is no limit.

choices.label: iTunes Store
choices.note: Songs from the iTunes Store's catalog

choices.label: Spelling help
choices.note: YouTube's search suggestions, used to respell a mistyped search

settings.title: Song search
settings.text: Where typed words are looked up. With both catalogs off, the search lists YouTube uploads instead.

choices.label: Automatic
choices.note: The neural aligner when its model can run, else signal analysis

choices.label: Neural
choices.note: The neural aligner (a 1.2 GB model, non-commercial licence)

choices.label: Signal only
choices.note: Signal analysis alone; never loads the model

settings.title: Lyric timing
settings.text: How lyrics are timed to the singing.
